  33. GitHub Agentic Workflows v1.3.1

    GitHub Agentic Workflows

    Prerelease

    Released
    18 Nov 2026
    Changes
    161

    v1.3.1 focuses on safer defaults, connector-based integrations, and schedules that no longer fire at the same minute. Several changes need migration steps, so review the breaking changes first.

    Key changes

    • v1.3.1 focuses on safer defaults, connector-based integrations, and schedules that no longer fire at the same minute. Several changes need migration steps, so review the breaking changes first.
    $ gh release view v1.3.1 --repo github/gh-aw
    All 161 changes

    🌟 Release Highlights 1

    • v1.3.1 focuses on safer defaults, connector-based integrations, and schedules that no longer fire at the same minute. Several changes need migration steps, so review the breaking changes first.

    ⚠️ Breaking Changes 11

    • Model routing default changed. Eligible workflows that set neither model nor routing now default to goal: cost with mode: auto routing on Copilot inference. Set engine.model-routing: false to keep the previous selection, or set a model explicitly. Recompile and review cost changes. Model routing
    • Native Jira, Linear, and Azure DevOps integrations replaced by connectors. Legacy auth and allowed settings and the old connectors gateway wrapper are rejected. Import .github/workflows/connectors/<provider>.md, select read profiles and write effects, configure credentials, and recompile. Connectors
    • Network transport bundles narrowed. Direct model API hosts were removed from Copilot, Codex, Gemini, and Pi defaults. Opt in with copilot-vendor, codex-vendor, or gemini-vendor. Claude needs api.anthropic.com allowed explicitly. Inline threat detection no longer auto-allows npm; add node to network.allowed if needed. Network
    • pull_request_target admits same-repository PRs only by default. Omitting forks now equals forks: []. Add exact owner/repo entries or trusted owner/* patterns to admit forks. Triggers
    • merge-pull-request blocks changes to protected files. Merge those PRs manually, add safe-outputs.merge-pull-request.protected-files.exclude entries, or set protected-files: allowed, then recompile. Safe outputs
    • Checksum pins required for AWF and Copilot CLI downloads. Downloads without a reviewed pin (sandbox.agent.checksums-sha256 or engine.checksums-sha256), and latest downloads, now fail closed. Attestation checks were removed. Sandbox
    • Unenforced GitHub MCP access controls rejected. tools.github.roles and tools.github.private-repos now fail compilation. Remove them; do not rely on them for authorization.
    • Work queue and grading moves. Global queue config moves to .github/workflows/aw.json under work_queue. Standalone policy seeding is removed; submit work with gh aw work-queue submit-work. graders.operational-value.run is removed; migrate to graders.operational-value.script. Work queue
    • Reporting renames. --outcomes, --outcomes-dir, and GH_AW_OUTCOMES_DIR are now --adoption, --adoption-dir, and GH_AW_ADOPTION_DIR. Standalone reporting is removed. Delivery and adoption
    • Logs and MCP defaults. gh aw logs caps storage at 1 GB by default; use --max-storage 0 for unlimited. MCP write tools (add, update, fix, compile) are disabled unless the server runs with gh aw mcp-server --allow-write-tools.
    • Experimental Atomic engine withdrawn. Remove any Atomic engine configuration. No replacement is provided.

    ✨ What's New 7

    • Scattered interval schedules. every N days, weeks, and months now spread run times instead of all firing at 00:00 UTC. The mo unit is documented. Recompile to apply. Schedule syntax
    • Router model values. model: router, router/economy, and router/balanced replace equivalent engine.model-routing blocks. Legacy syntax still works. Model routing
    • Safe-output lifecycle reporting. gh aw logs --delivery and --adoption report safe-output delivery and adoption. Delivery and adoption
    • OTLP metrics. Job duration, failures, token usage, tool calls, and safe-output volume are emitted when OTLP is configured, on by default. Set GH_AW_OTEL_METRICS: "false" to opt out. OpenTelemetry
    • Experimental connectors. azure-foundry-iq retrieves grounding from an Azure Foundry IQ knowledge base, and azure-web-iq provides Microsoft Web IQ search and browse. Both require explicit capability selection and approved queries. Connectors
    • Shared design review import. shared/elephant-goldfish.md runs fresh-context design-doc review from a single imports: line.
    • Repository issue label. A repository-level issue_label (default agentic-workflows) controls tracker lookup and cleanup. Recompile after changing it.

    🐛 Bug Fixes &amp; Improvements 10

    • Private reusable workflows no longer fail in activation.
    • Imported cache: settings now generate cache steps; previously they were silently dropped.
    • compile --dir .github/workflows now matches the default compile output.
    • gh aw update pins the setup action and built-in containers to the compiler version.
    • AWF installs on *.ghe.com no longer fail on attestation checks.
    • Failures before engine execution no longer show a misleading protected-capture error.
    • Copilot SDK bootstrap no longer breaks under strict pnpm policies.
    • Admission now runs inside the activation and conclusion jobs, removing extra runners.
    • CLI errors consistently use the gh aw prefix.
    • Security: Go 1.27.4 is required to build the repository and owned runtimes (GO-2026-6859, CVE-2026-97054). Setup-script temp files are now private, and API-key prefixes are no longer logged.

    📚 Documentation 3

    • The Cracktro talk deck gains kiosk mode, keyboard shortcuts, and per-slide search keywords.
    • Schedule, network, and CLI reference pages were updated to match current behavior.
    • > Generated by 🚀 Release · copilot · routed: haiku55 xhigh · \~3 AIC · ⊞ 7.6K

  39. GitHub Copilot SDK v2.0.0

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Stable

    Released
    17 Nov 2026
    Changes
    354

    v2.0.0 is a major release, including some changes most users will need to react to:. The SDK has been rebranded from GitHub Copilot SDK to Microsoft Copilot SDK (see announcement). All package names and namespaces have been renamed accordidngly.

    Key changes

    • v2.0.0 is a major release, including some changes most users will need to react to:
    • The SDK has been rebranded from GitHub Copilot SDK to Microsoft Copilot SDK (see announcement). All package names and namespaces have been renamed accordidngly.
    • Starting with v2.0.0, the Copilot runtime runs inside your application process by default; previously, the SDK spawned an external child process to host the runtime. While this can improve performance, simplify operations and makes the Copilot SDK behave more like other standard libraries, this can also trigger issues due to the removal of process isolation. To switch back to the previous, out-of-process mode, simply specify the following option when creating CopilotClient:
    • For the full list of breaking changes, see this document. Most changes are mechanical and the migration should be easy.
    $ gh release view v2.0.0 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 354 changes

    Changes 354

    • v2.0.0 is a major release, including some changes most users will need to react to:
    • The SDK has been rebranded from GitHub Copilot SDK to Microsoft Copilot SDK (see announcement). All package names and namespaces have been renamed accordidngly.
    • Starting with v2.0.0, the Copilot runtime runs inside your application process by default; previously, the SDK spawned an external child process to host the runtime. While this can improve performance, simplify operations and makes the Copilot SDK behave more like other standard libraries, this can also trigger issues due to the removal of process isolation. To switch back to the previous, out-of-process mode, simply specify the following option when creating CopilotClient:
    • For the full list of breaking changes, see this document. Most changes are mechanical and the migration should be easy.
    • Added PAC-aware system proxy routing support in the runtime, improving proxy handling in environments that use proxy auto-configuration.
    • The SDK now handles tokenizer warmup and process telemetry internally.
    • Remote session export refuses disabled or unresolved organization storage policy; SDK results expose export-start state and refusal warnings.
    • Defer allocator reclamation until disposed session data is released on opted-in Linux/glibc hosts, and preserve requests made during trim cooldown.
    • Fixed a runtime bug by adding the IPv6 unspecified address to the outbound request blocklist.
    • When streamer mode is enabled, models.list now masks hidden model names.
    • Fixed custom-agent list and reload returning incomplete catalogs during overlapping reloads or provider hydration, and stale catalogs after credential invalidation.
    • Fixed a bug where prompts could be altered when /after or /every text included the character U+0130.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where isAbortError could throw when an error message was not a string.
    • Session metadata and listing reuse unchanged log summaries and recover after transient log-read failures.
    • Built-in browser activation respects user preferences and managed policy, including after extension reconciliation.
    • Removed the unsupported prePRDescription and postResult variants from generated HookType contracts.
    • Preserve provider metadata in SDK model catalogs so provider information remains available when listing models.
    • Added ruleIndex to the session.fusion_resolved event payload.
    • Improved MCP OAuth compatibility by respecting advertised account-selection support and retrying a specific rejected selection once.
    • Clarified Copilot SDK documentation for pending permission recovery.
    • Sandbox deny rules support glob patterns, including hidden files and home-relative patterns, without changing literal grants.
    • SDK sessions now honor the host's COPILOT_MODEL_FAMILY setting when selecting the model family.
    • SDK clients now receive warnings related to live Marketplace plugins.
    • Runtime now loads .agents, .claude skills, and .claude agents from added directories.
    • Fixed an issue where session.mcp.startServer could ignore the provided configuration; it now honors the config passed by the caller.
    • Runtime now applies enabledPlugins from trusted non-repository folders during load, improving plugin activation consistency in Copilot SDK workflows.
    • Fixed a runtime issue where the grep tool now accepts flag names even when provided without a leading dash.
    • Preserve ACP context tier when switching models to keep context behavior consistent across model changes.
    • Local-model adoption and cleanup no longer open console windows on Windows.
    • Fixed MCP OAuth URL validation to reject backslash-obfuscated dot segments.
    • Improved runtime reliability: config key writes that are initially refused are now retried so updates are less likely to be lost.
    • Fix missing skill instructions when explicitly approving a tool permission after restarting the runtime.
    • Bugfix: INFO-level runtime logs no longer include MCP server peer information.
    • Fixed an issue where attachments could be dropped when a request was retried after rate limiting.
    • Normalized Responses MCP namespace names by trimming leading and trailing separators, keeping names that session history already used.
    • Azure OpenAI BYOK sessions on GPT-5.6/GPT-6 no longer send prompt_cache_breakpoint, restoring cross-turn prompt cache reuse.
    • Host tools that share the name of a built-in tool the session is not currently offering (for example exit_plan_mode outside plan mode) now run their handler instead of failing with "does not exist".
    • External tool calls no longer time out automatically after 30 minutes, allowing long-running human-in-the-loop workflows.
    • Fix intermittent custom-agent discovery failures when initial authentication completes during an SDK session's first agent scan.
    • Fixed a bug where LSP rootUri values resolving outside the repository Git root were accepted; they are now rejected.
    • Fix a race where an SDK connection closing could temporarily prevent another client from acquiring an idle Azure ML model family.
    • assistant.reasoning events now include the turnId, apiCallId and model of the model call that produced them.
    • Model-switch confirmations optionally report longContextLimit when the target model's higher context tier can fit the conversation.
    • Fixed a race that could leave shell or subagent completion notifications queued after an active turn finishes.
    • Fixed session.provider.add to accept whole-number token limits provided as floats (for example, 1000.0).
    • Forked sessions now keep the source session's SQL todo list (todos and todo_deps).
    • Fixed a bug where retried model calls could fail due to missing message IDs in streamed ACP chunks.
    • Runtime now captures image inputs and multimodal tool results in OpenTelemetry telemetry.
    • Fixed a Windows runtime bug in sandboxed child environments by standardizing PATH handling for more reliable command execution.
    • Fixed an issue where MCP OAuth tokens could fail to renew after being rejected during an idle liveness probe.
    • Managed settings: managedSettings.resolve/compose return the organization support URL as typed values.communication.support.url (experimental), so clients can link users to their org's help page.
    • Fix Python model capability token and vision limit serialization and preserve provider context-window configuration.
    • Fix assistant refusal:null replay for strict OpenAI-compatible BYOK providers.
    • Added experimental support for MCP skills in the runtime.
    • Python: Close owned runtime stdin during force_stop() so Windows launcher descendants can exit, without blocking the asyncio event loop.
    • Fix extension lifecycle state after a failed startup recovers through reload
    • Python: keep native runtime callbacks alive until their connection is confirmed closed, including after reader failures.
    • Align SDK OpenTelemetry capture settings with the standard GenAI environment variable while retaining legacy compatibility; usage events now expose the provider-returned response model separately from the requested model.
    • Fixed a client build performance issue by memoizing trust-anchor filtering to avoid re-filtering root certificates.
    • Standalone tool execution can recover after a session abort without starting another model turn.
    • Node.js: sendAndWait now honors timeouts above 2^31-1 ms, including Infinity, instead of timing out after 1 ms.
    • session.agent.list now returns the session's built-in agents when includeBuiltInAgents is true.
    • Fix plugin activation during managed-policy refresh and delivery of late background shell completion notifications.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where an LSP query that received a ContentModified response is now resent automatically.
    • Fixed a runtime OAuth callback issue by automatically retrying with a new MCP callback port if the previously saved port is refused.
    • Fixed Windows managed-sandbox admission probes attempting to launch a shell builtin without a shell.
    • Improved runtime behavior: the built-in GitHub MCP connection is now preserved across reloads when credentials are unchanged.
    • Sampling requests from MCP servers are now cancelled immediately when the host has not registered interest in sampling.requested, instead of waiting indefinitely.
    • Improved prompt-batch handling: if a user rejects one call, sibling prompts in the same batch now settle instead of staying pending.
    • .NET: Export tool callback activities through the github.copilot source so instrumented tool spans have observable parents.
    • On GNU/Linux, the runtime now prefers the operating system’s OpenSSL library.
    • Updated sandbox backends with Linux socket and io_uring restrictions and macOS path and terminal fixes.
    • Expose optional original tool-call IDs on preToolUse, postToolUse, and postToolUseFailure across all six SDKs, plus existing W3C tracing metadata in TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, and Java.
    • Return an error when sending with an unavailable model instead of silently choosing another model.
    • Autopilot now stops automatically after an accepted plan is completed.
    • On macOS console hosts, OneAuth sign-in dialogs now open in the foreground.
    • Fix cached MCP OAuth renewal incorrectly requiring permissions from the original authorization request when the approved grant is narrower.
    • Fixed a bug where a custom agent with the same name as a built-in agent could be silently shadowed; a warning is now surfaced.
    • Fixed hooks.discover reporting an unsupported-effect error and omitting --plugin-dir hooks on the default runtime.
    • Enabled session telemetry for eligible Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) sessions.
    • Fix sandbox networking so private MCP destinations follow outbound and host rules independently of loopback permission.
    • Add mcpResultMeta to tool.execution_complete results so hosts can restore an MCP App tool result's _meta after resume.
    • Improved error reporting by surfacing structured Policy Helper failures in the runtime.
    • Go: A panic in a slash-command or elicitation handler no longer crashes the process; the command fails with the panic value and the elicitation is cancelled.
    • Source selections now reach the model consistently in immediate steering and batched messages, just as they do when sent while idle.
    • Go: A request no longer blocks forever when the connection to a CLI the SDK started closes while that CLI keeps running; it fails with "connection closed" after up to a second.
    • Plan and autopilot tools now stay in the tool list after the first send in those modes, even with a replace-mode system message, so switching agentMode per send no longer breaks prompt-cache reuse.
    • Fixed a runtime issue so installed plugins continue to work after moving the Copilot home directory.
    • Sandbox denial suggestions recognize Go-style filesystem and Unix-socket errors when corroborated by the sandbox policy.
    • Improved session continuity in the runtime: long-running sessions can now be resumed from linked event journals.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where telemetry uploads are now paused while the collector is unreachable.
    • Updated runtime approval behavior: shell scripts that fail to parse now require full-script approval before execution.
    • Fixed Azure OpenAI BYOK session resume failures after an assistant returned no text or tool calls.
    • A failed tool.execution_complete event now includes result.content with the text sent to the model when it differs from error.message.
    • Auto metadata from models.list and session.model.list now reports providerId: "copilot" for token-authenticated clients, and omits it for catalogs served through a request handler.
    • Adds experimental host-owned Microsoft Entra acquisition callbacks in client options across all six SDKs.
    • Go: A panic in a CopilotRequestHandler transport, response body or WebSocket handler no longer crashes the process; the model request fails with the panic value.
    • Added a new SDK callback to support Kerberos authentication in runtime integrations.
    • Rust: A panic in an ExtensionLaunchProvider now answers the runtime with an error instead of delaying session creation by 15 s.
    • Improved error messages when a stdio MCP server fails to start by indicating whether the command or working directory is missing.
    • Honor client telemetry opt-out for OneAuth authentication diagnostics and preserve inherited environment settings in Rust in-process clients.
    • Configure OneAuth MATS application identity with optional entra.matsAppName; omitting it disables MATS without disabling authentication.
    • Fixed a runtime issue where connector servers could fail to start after reconcile in sessions that have no MCP servers.
    • Added session.permissions.configure fields authenticatedAuthority, for owner-authenticated permission grants, and hostPolicyPermissionHandler, so a host settles its own tools in Assisted Autopilot; judge denials now tell the agent the reason.
    • .NET: The default CopilotRequestHandler no longer cuts off model calls whose response takes more than 100 s to start; the runtime's request timeout governs the wait instead.
    • Improved runtime reliability: session events are now persisted in publication order before shutdown.
    • BYOK providers with modelProvider: "azure_openai" (for example Azure OpenAI behind a proxy or custom domain) now omit explicit prompt-cache breakpoints, like Azure OpenAI hosts.
    • Rust: A panic in a CopilotRequestHandler, WebSocket handler or forwarder response hook now fails the model request instead of leaving the turn waiting for a response that never comes.
    • Update Node.js dependencies and generated TypeScript map typings to include undefined for missing entries.
    • Added built-in cross-provider model fallback support to improve resilience when a selected model is unavailable.
    • Sessions using Gemini or Kimi models through Copilot now downscale or remove image attachments before sending a request over the 5 MiB limit, instead of failing with HTTP 413 and forcing a compaction.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where /env incorrectly showed an SDK client’s built-in plugins as installed.
    • All SDKs: a capabilities.changed event now updates only the capabilities it names; capabilities it leaves out are no longer dropped from session.capabilities. Java no longer fails to deliver such an event to subscribers.
    • Failed Connectors can recover during MCP reload after their account credentials change.
    • Rust: A panic in a slash-command handler now fails the command with "command handler panicked" instead of leaving it pending.
    • The standalone runtime now requires the user's consent before an extension that skips tool permission prompts, registers hooks, handles permission requests or observes them loads; a stored approval or allow-all grants it.
    • Improved MCP connection behavior in the runtime by attempting HTTP MCP discovery first, then falling back to legacy discovery.
    • Fixed canvas tools (open_canvas, list_canvas_capabilities, invoke_canvas_action) failing with "Session not found" when called from a task subagent.
    • Fix: when a session filesystem provider fails a view stat with an error other than ENOENT, the tool now reports that error instead of "Path does not exist".
    • Fixed coauthor preference inheritance when creating subagents.
    • Forward host editor identity from the SDK runtime to Copilot API requests.
    • Added SDK support to list the configured model for legacy single-provider sessions.
    • Fixed a bug where file edit operations could incorrectly replace non-UTF-8 characters throughout an entire file.
    • Fixed a bug where SDK model switch requests could affect the wrong session; model switches now apply only to the session they were issued in.
    • Fixed a runtime event-publication deadlock that could stall sessions sharing a process.
    • Shell tool calls emit session.background_tasks_changed only when the background task list changes, instead of once per internal step.
    • Fixed a bug where resuming a session could crash if the session log contained a deeply nested record.
    • Fixed a bug where calling session.resume with non-object parameters could abort the server.
    • Fixed a bug where refusal fallback could retry requests against a model disabled by an organization’s policy.
    • Session-summary failure diagnostics omit private parent directories.
    • Start model requests without waiting for host event acknowledgements, while preserving stop-hook ordering and cancellation.
    • Fixed a bug where rewind now reports agent edits even when the edited file exceeds the capture size limit.
    • Reduced memory growth in non-streaming sessions by limiting retained transient events.
    • Session event-log reads now return promptly when a session disconnects instead of waiting for the long-poll timeout.
    • Java: ToolInvocation.getArgumentsAs now deserializes java.time fields such as Instant and LocalDate instead of throwing IllegalArgumentException.
    • Node.js: generated types now carry the schema description as JSDoc on properties that reference a shared type, such as HistoryRewindResult.outcome.
    • Fixed: tool.execution_complete.result.citableSources is populated again, so sources a tool returns stay citable after a session is resumed.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where whole-log event snapshot refresh now returns the full history in a single native buffer.
    • Fixed a bug so custom agents are now rejected when their name is empty or duplicates another agent name.
    • Fixed web_fetch to decode web pages using the page’s declared character set instead of always assuming UTF-8.
    • Fixed a runtime-supervised AHP host joining an application's session unregistering that session's skill provider.
    • Add session.permissions.clearResumeEscalation to drop a resumed session's allow-all or assisted posture for the current run without recording it.
    • Fixed a runtime issue where an unreachable MCP registry could be reported as a policy denial, improving error reporting accuracy.
    • Fixed a bug in Python SDK code generation that could cause a crash when processing numeric constant values.
    • Java: PermissionRequestResultKind.hashCode now agrees with equals for kinds that differ only by non-ASCII case, so such kinds work as HashMap keys and HashSet members.
    • Fixed session.idle after an abort sometimes missing aborted: true when the previous turn's idle was still being delivered.
    • Fixed a bug where getBuiltinDescriptors responses could violate their result contract.
    • Python and Go: an empty MCP server map (mcp_servers={}, an empty MCPServers map) passed when creating or resuming a session is now sent instead of dropped, so resuming with it removes the session's MCP servers, as in the other SDKs.
    • Go: embeddedcli.Path() now checks the bundled CLI against CliHash before installing it, and an install that fails partway no longer leaves a partial file that blocks later installs.
    • Fixed a bug in truncateSummaries where keepCount kept the oldest summaries instead of the newest as documented.
    • Fixed a bug where plugin installs and updates could conflict when multiple processes accessed the marketplace at the same time.
    • Rust: the suppress_resume_event docs now say it skips the session.resume event; it never changed what happens when the session does not exist.
    • Report plugin activation warnings from the managed policy that applies to a session, even when the client attaches while that policy is still publishing.
    • Fixed a bug where session.metadata.snapshot could omit the session's client name.
    • Node.js, Go, .NET, Java, Python and Rust: the useLoggedInUser docs now say that environment variable tokens such as COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN are ignored when it is false; pass the token through gitHubToken instead.
    • Fixed a web_fetch bug where pages hitting the 10 MiB limit inside a script, style, or comment were not reliably reported to the model as truncated.
    • Python: the default WebSocket forwarder relays upstream messages up to 64 MiB instead of failing above 1 MiB.
    • An MCP server disabled before the session's first MCP load, including one started with a supplied config, now stays disabled through that load instead of restarting with its tools offered to the model.
    • Improved write_agent error messages to identify conflicting selectors and explain how to proceed.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where local plugins with identical directory names could incorrectly share a cache directory.
    • Python: session events received over a TCP connection are now routed with the same session-map locking as stdio.
    • Rust: a JSON-RPC frame whose header declares more memory than the host can reserve no longer aborts the process; the body is buffered as it arrives.
    • Fixed a bug in file_search where negation patterns after a wildcard could incorrectly exclude matching files.
    • Go: a session event handler that is busy, or that makes an RPC call, no longer stops the client from reading its connection, so other calls and sessions keep working while it runs.
    • Fixed a bug where MCP requests could hang or behave unexpectedly on oversized stdio responses; requests now fail immediately when a response exceeds the 16 MiB line limit.
    • Node.js: a workflow's ctx.log() and ctx.phase() now throw a TypeError when given a value that is not a string, instead of failing a later ctx.step() or ctx.agent() with an unrelated error and dropping progress lines.
    • Added opt-in session management tools in the runtime.
    • Node.js: concurrent listModels() calls on one client now share a single model list request instead of each sending its own.
    • Fixed a runtime issue where fallback handling could incorrectly enforce a prompt limit for models with unknown token limits.
    • Python and .NET: ToolSet now rejects a tool name with a trailing newline, as the other SDKs do, instead of building a filter entry that matches no tool.
    • Saving or resetting a setting with user.settings.set now takes effect when settings.json still holds an older spelling of the same key (for example copy_on_select), instead of reporting success while the old value stays in effect.
    • Fixed a Java SDK issue where concurrent listModels() calls could each trigger a separate model-list fetch.
    • Fixed: server-level plugins.* methods called without a session now register the retired copilot-plugins marketplace for users with plugins installed from it, so plugins.marketplaces.list, browse and update find it.
    • Runtime now preserves currently registered plugin hooks while trust admission is queued.
    • Local MCP servers are now started once per session after the first credential is resolved.
    • Node.js: the default WebSocket request forwarder now sends the request headers, including authorization, on the upstream handshake.
    • .NET: hook outputs whose ModifiedArgs or ModifiedResult is an anonymous object or a caller-defined class now reach the runtime when reflection-based serialization is enabled, instead of failing the hook call.
    • account.login now rejects a login that does not match the token's user, and stores the token under the user's own login spelling.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where an unreadable managed MDM sandbox allowlist could incorrectly allow all hosts.
    • .NET: a request whose error response the client cannot read now fails instead of never completing, and the connection keeps working.
    • Java: CopilotSession.compact() now compacts the session instead of failing with "Unhandled method session.compaction.compact".
    • Fixed an issue where ACP message chunks could lose the metadata for the subagent that produced them.
    • Fixed a runtime issue by adding COPILOT_PROVIDER_VISION, enabling BYOK tool images to reach the model.
    • Go: a tool result with empty TextResultForLLM is now sent to the model as empty text instead of a Go struct dump of the whole result.
    • Fixed an issue where a crashed session could remain marked as in use if its process ID was later reused.
    • Fixed a runtime issue where export events could be emitted while a deferred Mission Control creation was still in progress.
    • Fixed a bug where plugin rules using comma-separated glob patterns were not applied.
    • Fixed a runtime issue where skills skipped during loading from skillDirectories were not reported.
    • Java: a slash-command or tool handler whose future fails now reports its exception message without the exception class name in front of it.
    • Reuse valid saved MCP OAuth credentials on anonymous connections and initial challenges without requiring another sign-in.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where an unknown run_dynamic_workflow name did not list the registered workflows.
    • Fixed a runtime issue where tools could fail for the remainder of the first turn if ambient gh login completed after the turn started.
    • Fixed: a sessions.open handoff of a remote session no longer fails when the local working tree has uncommitted changes; they stay in place and the check-changes progress step reports them.
    • Improved Copilot SDK getting-started docs by ensuring the telemetry TypeScript and Go examples compile.
    • Added SDK access to provider status, permission capabilities, and the autopilot stay preference for clients.
    • Fixed doubled backslashes in Node.js extension examples in the SDK documentation.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where an LSP server that crashed during startup could remain incorrectly marked as "starting".
    • Fixed an SDK bug where max_output_tokens could be omitted from listed model limits in the Python, Go, .NET, and Java SDKs.
    • Fixed workflow registration validation to reject unknown fields and non-object values in workflow limits.
    • session.abort() now delivers the ephemeral cancellation session.info notice, as interruptMainTurn already did
    • Fixed session_history so searches and reads operate on message text instead of JSON-encoded content.
    • The bundled opt-in plugins Browser Use (browser-use) and Computer Use (computer-use), when registered through builtinPluginDirectories, now stay inactive until enabled (enabledPlugins or plugins.enable), as in the interactive CLI.
    • .NET SDK docs: four more README examples are compiled by the docs check.
    • Rust SDK docs: README examples now compile as doctests, including a corrected elicitation handler example.
    • Extensions no longer request elevated access after their connection closes during permission initialization.
    • Concurrent deferred repository-hook loads no longer rebuild already loaded hooks or report a nonzero count twice.
    • SDK clients now receive session.mcp_server_status_changed for MCP servers declared by a custom agent, tagged with the sub-agent's agentId, including a server that fails to start.
    • Fixed a runtime bug so tool output spill files are now created with owner-only permissions.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where a directory grant could be kept when the current working directory moved outside it under allow-all mode.
    • Resuming an Autopilot objective no longer starts a duplicate continuation if its prior run already continued during persistence.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where non-vision models are now correctly informed when a tool image is not provided.
    • Fixed a Windows plugin uninstall issue where users could see a bare "Access is denied" error when another program had a plugin file open.
    • Managed-extension launch diagnostics are now retained only when launch fails.
    • Windows clients now continue proxy discovery when DHCP returns an empty or whitespace-only PAC URL.
    • Large pastes saved through session.workspaces.saveLargePaste in the same millisecond no longer overwrite each other.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where the working directory was not restored after a change was rejected.
    • Fixed an issue where workflow run details could fail to report activity for running agents.
    • Fixed a bug where session.abort() could hang indefinitely when an MCP server did not respond.
    • Fixed remote HTTP MCP servers failing to connect through proxies that require Kerberos (Negotiate) authentication.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where hooks could not detect sessions started by another hook, which could cause agentStop hook chains to never terminate.
    • Sessions now emit a durable session.warning (warningType: "steering_not_delivered", with originatingMessageId) for each steering message that had not been delivered when the session shut down.
    • Improved the Node.js SDK README by updating Image Support and Streaming examples to type-check correctly.
    • Fixed a bug where a subagent started in the same turn as a plan approval could end up with no tools when the session had an explicit tool allow-list.
    • Add experimental typed catalog.recommend APIs across all six SDKs, including typed product-validation refusals.
    • Fix Rust SDK test compilation under consumers that deny clippy::unwrap_used.
    • Runtime now preserves active prefixes during late skill reloads, preventing prefix loss after reloads.
    • User-input and exit-plan-mode handlers now receive the runtime request ID of the pending request (requestId). Breaking (Rust): UserInputHandler::handle and ExitPlanModeHandler::handle take a new optional request_id parameter after session_id.
    • Fix WebSocket forwarder recursively closing an upstream that is still connecting.
    • Fixed an issue where a preToolUse hook returning null for modifiedArgs could incorrectly fail the tool call.
    • Java: A tool defined without a handler is now declaration-only, as in the other SDKs: its calls stay pending for session.tools.handlePendingToolCall instead of failing with a NullPointerException message.
    • Rust: a tool handler that returns Err now fails the tool call like in the other SDKs, so the model sees a generic failure message instead of the error text. Return a failure ToolResult to show the model specific failure text.
    • Fixed a runtime queue bug where insertAt and updateText now accept empty display text, allowing a running item to be hidden.
    • Python and Go: an empty custom agent list (custom_agents=[], an empty CustomAgents slice) passed when creating or resuming a session is now sent instead of dropped, so resuming with it removes the session's custom agents, as in the other SDKs.
    • Clarified the CLI help text for --secret-env-vars to more accurately describe what the flag protects.
    • Python and Go: an empty tools list (tools=[], an empty Tools slice) passed when creating or resuming a session is now sent instead of dropped, so resuming with it removes the session's external tools, as in the other SDKs.
    • Node.js: a workflow run's ctx.signal is now aborted when the workflow body settles, so ctx.parallel() and ctx.pipeline() branches still running after a failed run stop at their next workflow call and signal-aware work is cancelled.
    • Fixed a bug where instructions.discover could omit repository instruction files that are not valid UTF-8.
    • handlePendingCommand now returns success: false when the command request was already resolved or does not exist, like the other pending-request responses.
    • Fixed: sessions.list with metadataLimit no longer returns empty, unnamed sessions past the limit; they were already omitted within it.
    • session.abort now emits the ephemeral session.info cancellation note ("Operation cancelled by user") that an in-process cancellation already emitted.
    • Java: CopilotClient.getState() now returns DISCONNECTED once the connection to the runtime has closed, for example after the runtime process exits, instead of continuing to report CONNECTED.
    • tasks.getProgress now reports recentOutput as an empty string for a shell task that has printed nothing, instead of the text "(no output yet)".
    • Fixed an issue where telemetry warnings raised during cold resume were not consistently preserved in the session log.
    • Fixed a bug where model request header error messages could include the rejected credential.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where the root agent span could be left unnamed when the selected agent defines a sessionStart hook.
    • Fixed a bug where OpenTelemetry traces could incorrectly report the provider as "github" after switching to a Windows ML model.
    • Python: handlers registered with session.on() are now called in the order they were registered, matching the other SDKs.
    • Fixed an MCP OAuth login issue by retrying the login probe without a protocol version, improving authentication reliability.
    • Fixed a runtime bug so MCP OAuth discovery transport failures are reported correctly instead of being shown as missing metadata.
    • session.resume now rejects a reasoningEffort the model is not entitled to, instead of accepting it.
    • Improved runtime reliability by preserving extension tool readiness during concurrent resume operations.
    • Fixed a prompt hook bug where empty replacements could clear the prompt; dropped replacements are now reported.
    • Fixed an MCP OAuth bug where bare-origin resource values are now sent with a trailing slash.
    • Document Agent Plugins authoring and clarify SDK plugin loading options.
    • Background task completions that arrive after an Autopilot run stops are now delivered with the next message and announced via a session.info event with infoType background_completion_deferred, instead of being discarded.
    • Fixed a bug where BYOK Chat Completions requests were sent with Copilot sampling defaults.
    • Fixed an issue where a SQL tool query that never completes could hang the session even after pressing Ctrl+C.
    • Fix native transport initialization on Linux OpenSSL builds missing unused optional algorithms and report unavailable required crypto capabilities without leaving model turns processing indefinitely.
    • Align MCP tool telemetry with GenAI semantic conventions, including standard method/stdio transport attributes and structured failure reporting.
    • SDK sessions now stay in autopilot mode by default after an autopilot objective completes or pauses, matching the interactive CLI.
    • Improved reliability by automatically retrying Fusion plan requests after transient failures (HTTP 429/5xx or dropped connections).
    • Fixed a runtime bug where a tool result arriving before its corresponding tool call could be duplicated after the call.
    • Provider-registry (BYOK) models whose modelId (or id) exactly names a built-in model now get that model's editing tools, search tool and system prompt.
    • Fixed a runtime warning issue where a single oversized request could emit repeated warnings for each stripped attachment.
    • When a session's next request no longer fits in the model's context even after trimming older history, the turn now fails with the prompt-budget error instead of dropping the tool calls it just made and making them again.
    • Fix MCP OAuth credential coordination and bounded recovery when a newly adopted cached token is rejected.
    • On Windows, built-in PowerShell tool commands that run cls, clear or Clear-Host no longer fail with "The handle is invalid".
    • CLI: Explicit --model selections now take precedence over a custom agent’s configured model.
    • Tool definitions passed to session.tools.set or session creation now keep their schema's key order, so re-sending unchanged tools no longer breaks prompt caching.
    • Runtime preserves current skill catalogs during extension reconciliation so unchanged skills remain available to the first model request.
    • Fixed a Unix issue where BYOK API-key command helpers could continue running after timing out.
    • Runtime now preserves the inventory of disabled built-in plugins across refreshes.
    • Enabled context-management tools by default for MAI-code-2 models in the Copilot runtime.
    • All SDKs: permissions.paths.list() returns additionalDirectories and the explicit session additional directory grants (experimental).
    • extensions.discover() now includes extensions from enabled plugins installed from a local directory marketplace, matching what sessions load.
    • Fixed a bug where copilotUser lookup could retry after timing out.
    • Fixed an issue in the Copilot runtime where LSP fileExtensions keys are now accepted with or without a leading dot.
    • Java: @CopilotTool methods in a class nested inside another type now compile and register; a private nested tool class gets a processor error instead of uncompilable generated code.
    • Fixed a bug where MCP, LSP, and plugin manifest files saved with a UTF-8 BOM were incorrectly rejected.
    • Improved the Node.js SDK README by updating Permission Handling examples to type-check correctly.
    • Runtime now prevents block compaction when buffers are exhausted and surfaces history truncation to callers.
    • Custom subagents with private MCP connections avoid starting inherited servers excluded by their resolved tool list.
    • Session metadata from getSessionMetadata and listSessions now includes clientName, the client that created the session, and lastClientName, the client that last ran it, when known.
    • Rust: Breaking: SessionMetadata adds client_name and last_client_name; code that builds SessionMetadata with a struct literal or destructures all of its fields must handle them.
    • Fixed a bug where stop_bash could incorrectly report a non-existent shell ID as successfully stopped.
    • Fix Kerberos auth callback handling: .NET callbacks no longer block the JSON-RPC reader, Go releases startup waiters when a start fails, and Python answers cancelled callbacks and cancels in-flight callbacks when the connection closes
    • Node.js: a request whose params cannot be serialized no longer marks the client disconnected, so a later start() no longer launches a second runtime.
    • Improve Claude token estimates used for session context budgeting.
    • Sandbox blockedHosts now also match visible TLS SNI in CONNECT tunnels.
    • instructions.getDiscoveryPaths, skills.getDiscoveryPaths and agents.getDiscoveryPaths now return absolute paths when a projectPaths entry is relative.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where settings merges could overwrite an unreadable settings.json; merges now leave that file unchanged.
    • Local workspace diffs use the session's current working directory instead of stale persisted workspace metadata.
    • Sandboxed Hugo commands receive Hugo and Go cache grants when developer-tool access is enabled.
    • Shell safety warnings are no longer duplicated as standalone session.info events; permission-request warnings and tool errors are unchanged.
    • Added validation for reasoning effort values before they are accepted or persisted.
    • Improved runtime caching so MCP call results are preserved across unrelated snapshot refreshes.
    • Added SDK contracts to expose GitHub services through the runtime.
    • Keep credential assignments redacted across detached-shell output pages.
    • Added optional causal provenance to inter-agent session events.
    • Clarified errors when a managed sandbox cannot be enforced.
    • For authenticated github.com sessions, the runtime now automatically uses a default secret-scanning endpoint.
    • Eligible WorkIQ OAuth requests use the host's Entra identity with M365 inference, including manual configuration and token renewal, while preserving explicit opt-outs.
    • Expose Team marketplaces through plugin APIs.
    • Fix access to bundled search binaries in sandboxed SDK sessions when developer-tool access is enabled.
    • Switching a concrete-model session to Auto now reconciles unavailable retained tier preferences before validation; explicit tier requests remain strictly validated.
    • Fusion model switches accept a null reasoning-effort reset while continuing to reject unsupported effort values.
    • Sessions created with customAgents and enableConfigDiscovery or agentDirectories now list discovered agents, such as .github/agents files, from the first agent.list() instead of only after agent.reload().
    • Requests can fall back to direct networking when system proxy or PAC resolution fails.
    • Fixed a bug where hook configuration files encoded with a UTF-8 BOM were incorrectly ignored.
    • Fixed a bug where LSP files matched by an empty extension mapping did not use the configured languageId; the configured languageId is now sent.
    • Java: The deprecated parentToolCallId property of the assistant message, message delta, usage, tool execution start and tool execution complete event data is now marked @Deprecated, as in the other SDKs.
    • Honor HTTP 429 Retry-After timing using existing request policies without adding queue-wide or worker-stop behavior.
    • Fixed an issue where setting session.mcp.disable after the first MCP load could be lost on the next reload.
    • Unlisted GPT models now use GPT-6.1 defaults, and unlisted Claude models use Sonnet 5.5 defaults with a 48K output cap and no configured default refusal fallback.
    • Java previews with the same base SDK version now update one rolling Maven snapshot coordinate.
    • Fixed plugin uninstall behavior so listed plugins can be removed even when their files are missing.
    • Sessions created on the standalone runtime host now return before their extensions start, so an extension's startup consent prompt reaches the client.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where continuations with no usage were incorrectly reported as prompt-cache breaks.
    • Fixed premature extension readiness reporting that could cause an unrelated extension to restart during a managed-policy refresh.
    • A session whose events cannot be persisted now emits a session.error (errorType: "persistence") when persistence starts failing, repeats it every 10th failed attempt while it lasts, and emits one session.info (infoType: "persistence") when it recovers, instead of a session.error on every retry.
    • Fixed an issue where failed HTTP MCP tool calls could display an internal type name in the error message.
    • Sessions created or resumed with a stored Efficiency Auto preference that the account's Auto metadata no longer lists now start and route on the provider default, instead of failing every turn.
    • Java and Python SDKs now preserve experimental markers on RPC properties.
    • Explicitly reap POSIX stdio MCP child processes during normal awaited shutdown.
    • Preserve application-defined request metadata in MCP App tool calls.
    • Fixed extensions being stuck behind a pending managed policy after the first turn when the session used a token for the signed-in account.
    • A leading ~ or ~/ in skillDirectories, agentDirectories, instructionDirectories or hookDirectories now resolves to the home directory instead of a folder named ~ under the working directory.
    • Added a warning when a top-level SKILL.md in a skills directory hides its skills.
    • Node.js, Python, Go, .NET and Rust: stop() no longer waits forever on a runtime that stops responding while sessions are attached; session detach now shares the 10-second shutdown timeout and a detach that does not finish is reported as a stop error.
    • Add agent attribution to lifecycle progress diagnostics
    • Fixed a runtime issue where preToolUse hooks were not executed concurrently for parallel tool calls.
    • Resuming a session on the same connection now replaces the slash commands that connection registered before: a new commands list replaces them and commands: [] removes them, instead of leaving commands listed that can no longer run.
    • Auto model selection no longer falls back to the legacy Auto API when /auto fails; the turn retries once and then fails with a clear error.
    • Fix a standalone session startup race between initial managed-policy publication and repository-hook loading.
    • Fixed a bug where LSP rename applied its WorkspaceEdit as a single change.
    • Fixed a runtime bug where abort requests could hang if the host did not respond to tool hook or bearer token callbacks.
    • session.rpc.shell.exec now honours a timeout above 4294967295 ms (capped there) or a fractional one (rounded up) instead of using the 30-second default, and rejects a negative or non-numeric timeout with an invalid-params error.
    • Fixed web_fetch to decode an XML document in the encoding its XML declaration names when the server sends no charset, instead of as UTF-8.
    • createSession and resumeSession now reject a workingDirectory that is relative (including ~) or is not a directory, instead of silently using the runtime's own directory.
    • Fixed empty input hints in session.commands.list for built-in commands that declare only choices.
    • session.options.update now rejects a workingDirectory that does not exist, is not a directory, or cannot be entered, and leaves the session in its current directory.
    • Fixed duplicate session.created and session.deleted events from the CLI SDK server.
    • Fixed: sign-in flows started with session.accounts.login.begin are cancelled when their session is disconnected, so they no longer block other sessions from signing in.
    • session.send, sendAndWait and sendMessages now reject a mode other than "enqueue" or "immediate" with an error, instead of silently queueing the message as "enqueue".
    • Fixed customizations.reload incorrectly reporting unloadable custom agent files as reloaded.
    • Protected sessions can read their selected extension SDK's authoring references without additional sandbox path grants.
    • Coalesce renewable GitHub CLI credential acquisition and retry a transient helper timeout once without switching accounts.
    • Fixed an issue where ACP clients could not leave autopilot in sessions started with --yolo.
    • Improved telemetry privacy by redacting credentials from engine message telemetry.
    • Python: Rename the internal copilot.generated package to copilot._generated; import protocol types through copilot.rpc or copilot.session_events.
    • Renamed public SDK identity branding to "Microsoft Copilot SDK".
    • Breaking: Group client and session options across all six SDKs and create/resume/open/update RPCs, keep configDirectory and enableConfigDiscovery at the session root, retain explicit spawned-versus-attached runtime connection factories with grouped ownership settings, and require SDK protocol 4.
    • Replace singular inference.provider with named provider connections and model rows, adding default-provider alias routing, explicit CAPI disablement, and consistent resume policy across SDKs.
    • Managed settings can make the built-in Browser Use plugin unavailable with features.browserUse: false.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v2.0.0 Changelog Release notes →

    • Python: Rename the internal copilot.generated package to copilot._generated; import protocol types through copilot.rpc or copilot.session_events.
    • Renamed public SDK identity branding to "Microsoft Copilot SDK".
    • Breaking: Group client and session options across all six SDKs and create/resume/open/update RPCs, keep configDirectory and enableConfigDiscovery at the session root, retain explicit spawned-versus-attached runtime connection factories with grouped ownership settings, and require SDK protocol 4.
    • Replace singular inference.provider with named provider connections and model rows, adding default-provider alias routing, explicit CAPI disablement, and consistent resume policy across SDKs.
    • Managed settings can make the built-in Browser Use plugin unavailable with features.browserUse: false.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v2.0.0-preview.1 Changelog Release notes →

  47. GitHub Agentic Workflows v1.3.0

    GitHub Agentic Workflows

    Prerelease

    Released
    16 Nov 2026
    Changes
    271

    v1.3.0 makes declarative connectors the way to integrate external services, promotes ledgers out of experimental, and tightens security and merge defaults. Several changes need action on upgrade, so review the breaking changes first.

    Key changes

    • v1.3.0 makes declarative connectors the way to integrate external services, promotes ledgers out of experimental, and tightens security and merge defaults. Several changes need action on upgrade, so review the breaking changes first.
    $ gh release view v1.3.0 --repo github/gh-aw
    All 271 changes

    🌟 Release Highlights 1

    • v1.3.0 makes declarative connectors the way to integrate external services, promotes ledgers out of experimental, and tightens security and merge defaults. Several changes need action on upgrade, so review the breaking changes first.

    ⚠️ Breaking Changes 10

    • Native provider integrations replaced by connectors. Native Jira, Linear, and Azure DevOps tools, handlers, and gateway issue triggers are removed. Import the provider from .github/workflows/connectors/<provider>.md, select read profiles and write effects, configure credentials, and recompile. Connectors reference
    • Model routing on by default for Copilot. Eligible workflows with no model or routing now use goal: cost and mode: auto. Set engine.model-routing: false to keep the previous selection. Model routing
    • pull_request_target admits same-repository PRs only by default. Add exact owner/repo or trusted owner/* entries to forks to admit forks.
    • merge-pull-request blocks PRs that change protected files. Use protected-files.exclude for scoped exceptions, or set protected-files: allowed when intentional.
    • Pinned checksums required for AWF and Copilot CLI downloads. Supply sandbox.agent.checksums-sha256 or engine.checksums-sha256 with an explicit version. latest downloads now fail closed.
    • Graders run in conclusion or a separate graders job. Recompile to move grading out of the agent job. Bash graders read the session JSONL from $1 or GH_AW_SESSION_FILE.
    • CLI changes. gh aw outcomes is replaced by gh aw logs --outcomes. gh aw logs defaults to a 1 GB storage budget (--max-storage 0 for unlimited). MCP workflow-writing tools (add, update, fix, compile) are disabled unless gh aw mcp-server --allow-write-tools is set.
    • Work queue configuration moves to .github/workflows/aw.json under work_queue. Standalone policy seeding is removed; submit work with gh aw work-queue submit-work. Work queue reference
    • compile --dry-run omits steps and post-steps code and rejects pre-steps, custom MCP servers, and enabled Bash graders.
    • Log episode fields renamed. root_run_id and primary_workflow become representative_run_id and representative_workflow. Episodes require a recorded context.episode_id.

    🔒 Security 4

    • Go 1.27.4 is required for builds, tooling, and release binaries, fixing GO-2026-6859 (an HTTP/1 server crash). Rebuild local binaries and devcontainers.
    • Staged filenames can no longer inject zip options (#78015).
    • Setup scripts harden against symlink traversal (#77552).
    • Same-repository PR checkout for on.bots Apps is limited to body-only edited events (#78236 trusts the agentic autofix bot in API proxies).

    ✨ What's New 10

    • Declarative connectors replace native provider integrations (#77333). Learn more
    • Ledgers are no longer experimental (#77331). storage: comment-memory stores ledgers in issue or PR comment memory (#77362). Ledger replay
    • Trigger reaction cleanup with on.reaction.remove-on-complete (#77561).
    • Agent-success gate with safe-outputs.require-agent-success: true blocks publication after a failed agent job (#77559).
    • Runtime routing level: a model: expression can choose the routing level when the run starts (#77588).
    • Default issue-update operation: set safe-outputs.update-issue.operation (#77558).
    • Pricing from AWF: gh-aw no longer bundles a model pricing catalog (#77471).
    • Engine updates: OpenRouter vendor-prefixed model IDs work in Pi workflows (#77562), and OpenCode supports model rosters and empty-run continuation (#78131).
    • Workflow source in JSON: gh aw list --json exposes the source field (#77866).
    • Shared Graphify indexing: a read-only search workflow (#78088).

    🐛 Bug Fixes &amp; Improvements 9

    • Instruction contracts fit in the first 8,000 UTF-8 bytes that Copilot CLI exposes (#77481).
    • Signed PR branches are created at the first commit (#77555) and can be pushed under non-blocking rulesets (#77556).
    • Completion comments no longer duplicate attribution footers (#77482).
    • Safe outputs skip ledger persistence when they do not succeed (#77480).
    • The Auditor tolerates health timeouts and degrades subprocess timeouts to deferred evidence (#77439, #78232).
    • Daily Graft reports complete with native CLI queries (#77844, #78167).
    • PR Sous Chef refreshes same-repo bot PRs behind the integrity proxy (#78203).
    • Copilot cybersecurity-policy rejections are no longer retried (#77351).
    • The main build compiles again (#77643).

    📚 Documentation 4

    • Connectors reference is trimmed (#78200). Safe-outputs PR and checkout references are trimmed (#77946, #77595).
    • A/B experiments graduate out of the experimental section (#78181).
    • The Cracktro talk adds a slide map, fuzzy search, and new agentic engineering slides (#78163, #78149).
    • > Generated by 🚀 Release · copilot · routed: haiku55 xhigh · \~2 AIC · ⊞ 7.6K

  52. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.34

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Stable

    Released
    14 Nov 2026
    Changes
    52

    Fixed false MCP startup session.error events when quitting or switching sessions cancels in-progress MCP startup; genuine startup failures on live sessions are still reported. Fixed session.plugins.list incorrectly reporting user-installed plugins as disabled when an organization requires managed plugins; enabled states now respect user settings unless explicitly overridden.

    Key changes

    • Fixed false MCP startup session.error events when quitting or switching sessions cancels in-progress MCP startup; genuine startup failures on live sessions are still reported.
    • Fixed session.plugins.list incorrectly reporting user-installed plugins as disabled when an organization requires managed plugins; enabled states now respect user settings unless explicitly overridden.
    • Fix taskAnalytics.classifyTrajectory retries rejecting an unchanged archive whose JSON object keys were stored in a different order. Results from earlier versions need one fresh analysis.
    • TeamPluginMarketplaceSource in session.plugins.getDefaults includes the Team's ref and path when it sets them.
    $ gh release view v1.0.34 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 52 changes

    Changes 52

    • Fixed false MCP startup session.error events when quitting or switching sessions cancels in-progress MCP startup; genuine startup failures on live sessions are still reported.
    • Fixed session.plugins.list incorrectly reporting user-installed plugins as disabled when an organization requires managed plugins; enabled states now respect user settings unless explicitly overridden.
    • Fix taskAnalytics.classifyTrajectory retries rejecting an unchanged archive whose JSON object keys were stored in a different order. Results from earlier versions need one fresh analysis.
    • TeamPluginMarketplaceSource in session.plugins.getDefaults includes the Team's ref and path when it sets them.
    • Hardened TCP JSON-RPC servers to reject HTTP requests and disconnect clients sending invalid header names; standard SDK clients are unaffected.
    • ACP TCP servers now require loopback hosts and disconnect clients sending invalid UTF-8 or non-JSON lines; stdio behavior is unchanged.
    • Announced the transition to the Microsoft Copilot SDK.
    • Fixed retained Microsoft Entra metadata refresh and Microsoft 365 account projection consistency.
    • Fixed session.plugins.retryManaged on the standalone host to retry all or selected required plugins without waiting for the automatic retry pause, activate prepared plugins, and return per-plugin results and errors.
    • Add experimental saved-provider inspection, editing, and removal, with explicit session.provider updates for live application.
    • Sessionless discovery and inert plugin inventory now honor authenticated Team plugin defaults without changing saved preferences or activating contributions.
    • SDK sessions now use the model's preferred context tier when no explicit or saved tier is set; models without a preference retain existing behavior. Claude Haiku 5.5 sessions now default to a 936K prompt budget instead of 100K.
    • Defaulting to long context can incur higher token rates without explicit opt-in; billing still depends on actual prompt size.
    • Security-review scan tools disclose captured unchanged supporting context and distinguish changed-only, supporting-only, and mixed evidence blobs.
    • Fixed supported document attachments in GPT sessions using WebSocket Responses being sent as local file references instead of document contents.
    • Reduced peak memory usage and improved performance when forking sessions with large histories through sessions.fork.
    • Simplified sessions.fork write-failure messages from "Persistence error: I/O error: ..." to "I/O error: ...".
    • Windows SDK networking now enforces Windows certificate distrust even with custom CAs, and excludes distrusted certificates from trust bundles supplied to child processes.
    • Windows credential-proxy and affected tunneled HTTPS connections now use native Windows TLS, preserving revocation checks and support for non-exportable system client-certificate keys.
    • The native runtime no longer hangs at startup when another process holds its log directory's lock; it starts with process file logging disabled and a stderr warning.
    • session.rpc.history.setCompactionConfig({ model }) now applies to sessions using a custom (BYOK) provider: compaction summarizes on another model that provider serves, through the same provider.
    • Persisted session.usage_record events no longer store /interactions as the usage apiEndpoint, so runtimes released before that value can resume those sessions, and a usage record whose endpoint the runtime does not know now loads without it instead of failing the resume.
    • Fixed indexed search permanently falling back to scan-based search after temporary memory pressure. Sessions now retry within the indexing operation timeout, using scans until indexed search becomes available.
    • Enable dynamic workflows for Microsoft 365 accounts without requiring GitHub billing or BYOK configuration.
    • Preserve pending external tool requests when an SDK client disconnects during request publication.
    • Fix a race where subagent retirement after an external tool response could prevent the parent response from reaching the SDK.
    • Fixed plugins.install failing with "Marketplace not found" for an owner/repo:path source whose path contains @; it now installs from that repository path.
    • Fix providers.config.updateModel and updateProvider deleting saved capability and Azure settings that providers.config.read does not return.
    • Java: Javadoc now shows schema descriptions that contain a less-than sign as written, instead of an invalid input error or a hidden placeholder such as the token in Authorization: Bearer, and the SystemMessageMode.CUSTOMIZE and ToolResultObject.binaryResultsForLlm() references on SectionOverride, SectionOverrideAction, SystemMessageSections and ToolBinaryResult resolve.
    • A failed compaction reports the provider's error message in the session.history.compact error and in session.compaction_complete.error, without an internal host-rethrow prefix
    • BYOK providers on the WebSockets transport now run apiKeyCommand and bearerTokenProvider once per model request instead of twice.
    • Session AI credit limits now count the credits a session used before it was resumed, so a resumed session can no longer spend its full limit again.
    • Gemini models on the Interactions API stream a blank line between thought summaries in assistant.reasoning_delta, as the reasoning text of the same response has with streaming off
    • Fix in-process hosts ignoring COPILOT_DISABLE_KEYTAR from their isolated environment.
    • Node.js and Python: a relative CLI path (explicit path or COPILOT_CLI_PATH) is now checked in the client's working directory, where the runtime starts, instead of the process's current directory.
    • Python: CopilotClient.force_stop() on a TCP or URI connection no longer logs "Failed to parse incoming JSON-RPC message" with a traceback when a message was arriving as the connection closed.
    • Assisted permissions keep using the judge after a person approves an action too long for the judge to review, instead of falling back to manual prompts for the rest of the session.
    • Improved assisted permission checks in delegated sessions to distinguish agent claims from user authorization and better honor quoted user stop, pause, cancellation, and scope limits.
    • Fixed session listing with an empty filter to return the same sessions as an unfiltered call, including local sessions with no recorded working directory.
    • sessions.enrichMetadata now reports isDetached: true for a detached session that a sessions.list call with metadataLimit returned as not detached.
    • A sub-agent's client-tool call is now recorded as completed in the session history, and its external_tool.completed event carries the sub-agent's agentId like its request.
    • session.create and session.resume now report a model id the model list does not offer as not available when a reasoningEffort is also given, instead of as an unsupported reasoning effort.
    • Fixed an issue where an enabled plugin in a local directory marketplace whose source points to a file prevented all MCP servers from starting. The invalid plugin is now skipped with a warning identifying the plugin and path.
    • Fixed an issue where cancelling a finished sub-agent with session.tasks.cancel could leave the parent's session.idle event missing and sendAndWait pending after its background shells stopped.
    • API docs no longer name the nonexistent methods hooks.loadResources, user.settings.load, user.settings.governanceKeys and user.settings.unknownKeys or the nonexistent event session.context_info_changed; they name hooks.discover, user.settings.loadWithWarning, user.settings.listGovernanceKeys, user.settings.getUnknownKeysWarning and session.usage_info.
    • Fixed intention summaries for structured ask_user calls to show the question message instead of "Waiting for response"; legacy call summaries are unchanged.
    • Session events: session.permission_recovery attempts can carry an optional reviewIncomplete flag for a deferral caused by an automatic permission review that ended without a verdict (timeout, empty or unparseable reply).
    • Rewinding to a message sent with mode "immediate" while the agent was working now restores the files the agent changed in reply to it.
    • Fixed subagents ignoring session-wide usage when enforcing sessionLimits.maxAiCredits. Subagents now block further model calls once the soft cap is reached, make a final tool-free call when 10% or less remains, and skip response tool calls if the cap is exceeded during that response.
    • Fixed a lost queue wakeup when resuming during drain retirement.
    • Improve best-effort compatibility on unsupported macOS 13 systems without expanding official OS support. The bundled CLI requires macOS 13.5 or later; HPKE-dependent authentication now reports an explicit macOS 14 requirement.
    • All: Fixed Team plugin defaults after account changes while preserving explicit session credentials.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.34 Changelog Release notes →

    Key changes

    • A failed /compact now shows the model provider's error message without an internal host-rethrow prefix

    $ gh release view v1.0.112 --repo github/copilot-cli
    All 95 changes

    Changes 95

    • A failed /compact now shows the model provider's error message without an internal host-rethrow prefix
    • A prompt the CLI does not send yet, such as one entered while managed account policy is still loading, keeps its pasted text, so pressing Enter again sends the paste instead of the literal [Paste #N - M lines] placeholder
    • The /plugin manager no longer shows a repository plugin that did not load as enabled, and plugin lists no longer say its directory was not found when its source points outside the marketplace
    • copilot help sandbox now says that on macOS, sandbox host rules block direct TCP connections to local ports, such as a build client reaching its daemon; localhost stays reachable only through the local proxy, as HTTP or a CONNECT tunnel from a proxy-aware client
    • copilot workflow run --help now lists a Microsoft 365 account among the sign-ins that can run workflows, alongside usage-based billing and a custom model provider (BYOK) while signed out of GitHub
    • The /subagents model picker reopens for the same agent and accepts input after switching away from a session and back
    • Keep on/off states and model picker arrows visible in /subagents settings in narrow terminals
    • Opening a sub-agent's view no longer writes escape sequences or control characters from its task prompt to the terminal
    • /copy keeps its formatting when pasted into Word, Outlook or Teams, and keeps each message of a multi-message response as its own paragraph, table, list or quote
    • Model-switch prompts stay with the session that raised them and reappear when you return to that session
    • /settings list items display every character when typing or viewing saved values on terminals 20 columns wide or narrower
    • Permission prompts and other dialogs at the bottom of the screen no longer stay scrolled down after the terminal gets shorter and then taller again, so the extension environment-variable prompt shows the variable names it lists
    • /feedback warns when the additional logs path contributes no files to the feedback bundle
    • Emoji and other Unicode characters display correctly under the search cursor in the Issues and Pull requests tabs
    • Keep paths and variable names containing emoji or CJK characters correctly truncated and aligned in /sandbox
    • Links with balanced parentheses now open the full URL when clicked in your messages, shell commands, and shell output
    • Session limit dialogs stay with their session, leaving other sessions free for typing when you switch.
    • copilot mcp get correctly reports unconfigured server names such as toString as not found in text and JSON output
    • Sessions sidebar actions no longer create or switch sessions while the CLI exits, keeping the exit summary's resume commands valid
    • Text and number editors in /settings keep typed values visible inside the dialog on narrow terminals.
    • Tool previews keep emoji intact, display SQL and agent messages as plain text, and keep memory vote previews on one line
    • The @ file picker keeps emoji and accented characters intact and preserves the @ prefix when shortening paths in narrow terminals
    • /lsp logs error summaries fit the available width without splitting emoji, and server messages display as plain text
    • Arrow keys and Tab follow the highlighted action after using j/k or Ctrl+N/Ctrl+P in the /environments add-connection dialog
    • Pasted text stays in the correct position when you press Esc or Ctrl+C immediately after pasting in Vim mode
    • Keep the Sessions tab responsive when queued commands open dialogs such as /login
    • Ctrl+C reliably cancels newly queued prompts without running them or showing a submission failure.
    • Show the welcome header and Getting started box when cancelling the session picker at startup.

    • Tool permission prompts keep their title and selected answer visible in short terminals, with PgUp/PgDn to scroll command or file details
    • MCP system prompt reviews display plain text without allowing terminal controls to restyle, link, or hide content
    • /plugin clears the marketplace update badge and count when a re-check confirms no update is available

    • copilot help environment documents COPILOT_MCP_TOOL_CACHE again, the variable that turns off the MCP tool snapshot cache for every server
    • Agent, code search and IDE tool rows in the timeline show model- and IDE-written text as plain text instead of passing its escape sequences and control characters to the terminal
    • /model plan now refuses extra arguments instead of saving or clearing the plan model without them, and reads PLAN and --plan plan as the plan keyword
    • Question rows in the timeline show the question text while awaiting an answer, after you decline, and when Autopilot answers.

    • Keep the ellipsis visible on truncated session names in the Sessions tab, even in narrow terminals
